verdict.rationale: Pigment documents its own modeling capability: the Modeler Agent builds planning models from natural-language intent (pigment-docs-5), a function library supplies formula logic (pigment-docs-18), and workforce scenarios can be run to test different assumptions (pigment-docs-11), which touches on hiring assumptions. However, the evidence never explicitly describes driver-based models that replace hard-coded rows, so the depth of this capability is unproven. Missing for 10: explicit driver-based modeling documentation, evidence of growth and price-point assumption drivers, evidence that hiring drivers flow into the financial plan, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
